methodology: We analyzed 50 actual IR-unsafe query-budget cases using a structured model-assisted taxonomy. Cases initially flagged as uncertain were resolved through a second evidence-based model-assisted review using predefined numerical and semantic decision rules.
authorization: Researcher requested automatic second-pass resolution; this is not human verification of cases.
decision_rules: High ANN recall and unsafe IR first; observed small boundary next under explicit feature rule.
Clear rarity, ambiguity or complexity can follow; names or TREC membership alone are insufficient.
Use numerical low-recall fallback when semantic explanations lack clear support.
